reviews.text:
I always promise that I should increase the alcohol content first from the beer, but I wonder why the pub always comes second. Anyway, I stopped by Ringo, a mecca for McDucks on Sharosu-gil, while I was with a beer-loving friend.

There is another same store in Sillim-dong, and since that is the main branch, this is the branch, but somehow the number of blog reviews is higher here. This is closer to Seoul National University's main branch, and to Seoul National University Station.

The store consists of a first and second basement floor, and the entrance is connected to the basement, so you have to go up through the basement to get to the second floor. The second floor was full and there were only a few seats left in the underpass, so I sat at the counter.

We have a diverse lineup of draft and bottled beers, but as a ‘Guinness Master Quality’ business, we are focusing on Guinness. So, my friend ordered Guinness and I went to Kaiserdom Keller, the Keller beer.

Kellerbier is a lager brewed without filtering from an underground cellar and is a style handed down from the Bavarian region. Compared to Ayinger's Kellerbier, it was cloudy in color, smoother in taste and had a stronger yeast flavor.

I took a sip or two of Guinness from my friend and drank it, and the creamy foam was really nice. However, the layer that felt relatively thin when swallowed was thick, so it was difficult to call it an excellent pint.

The second glass was a heavy wheat beer and I went for Hefeweizen. This beer is produced by the Bayernstephan brewery in Bavaria. The savory body of wheat blends well with the banana flavor.

Personally, what I liked the most that day was similar to Sejong Dupont Saint and Belgium Aelo Kölsch. With its bright gold color, refreshing, refreshing carbonation, and clean finish, it seemed perfect to drink on an empty stomach.

reviews.author: Gourmet Tourist (danzzanaz)
reviews.text:
The atmosphere is really nice and the food is all delicious.
In particular, there are two things you must try when you come to this place: gnocchi and carbobo.

The gnocchi comes with a butter cream sauce. The gnocchi itself is delicious, but the butter cream sauce that comes with it is the best.
The taste of gnocchi, which can easily smell like flour, was enhanced by adding a thick, buttery cream sauce.

It's a taste that I want to eat at least once a week.
If you’ve never tried gnocchi, I highly recommend trying it here.

Carbo is a traditional carbo made with egg yolk and cheese as the base.
That's why it tastes really sticky and sticky.
It doesn't smell like eggs at all and has a really good chewy taste, so if you like chewy pasta, you should definitely give it a try.

I've been to this place a few times, but it feels like it's improving little by little each time I come, and the owner is very friendly.

This was my first time ordering pizza and this place does good pizza.

The atmosphere inside is also really comfortable and nice.
It has a slightly dark feel, so I feel like alcohol goes in better.

A place to introduce when you want to eat gnocchi or delicious pasta.

translation

The atmosphere is really nice and all the food is delicious. There are two things that you must try when you come here: the gnocchi and the carbonara.

The gnocchi comes with a butter cream sauce that is amazing. The gnocchi itself is tasty, but the buttery cream sauce really takes it to the next level. It adds a rich flavor to the gnocchi and eliminates any potential floury smell.

It's the kind of flavor that you want to experience at least once a week. If you haven't tried the gnocchi, I highly recommend giving it a shot here.

The carbonara is made in the traditional way with a base of egg yolk and cheese. As a result, it has a really rich and creamy taste. The egg flavor is not overpowering at all, and the chewy texture is really highlighted. If you're a fan of chewy pasta, you must try this dish.

I've been here a few times and it seems to be getting better each time. The owner is also very friendly.

I tried the pizza for the first time and it was also really good. The interior atmosphere is very cozy and comfortable. It's a bit dim, which makes it perfect for enjoying a drink.

If you're in the mood for delicious gnocchi or pasta, this is the place to go

reviews.text: As a beer lover, I was really pleased with the variety of draft beers here. From classic beers to creative cocktails like Honey Guinness Bomb, every beer was unique, high quality and full of flavor. It's not for nothing that people say that if you like beer, you won't like this place. However, the price is a bit high, so it is suitable for special occasions or occasional dining out. The atmosphere is comfortable yet sophisticated, perfect for a small gathering with friends or relaxing after work. Although it's not the best value for money, it's definitely worth a visit if you're a craft beer fanatic. The service was good, the food came out at a reasonable pace, and the staff seemed knowledgeable about beer. Overall, it's worth a visit at least once, and I'm willing to go again, but it's a bit tight on my wallet. It would be a good idea to introduce happy hour discounts or set menus so that more customers can enjoy them without burden.

reviews.author: 首尔外围Outcall&Incall
reviews.text: Overall, I was very pleased with this restaurant and it is a good option for a gathering in the area. The signature dish, braised pork belly, was tender, flavorful, and perfectly cooked, and the side dishes were also fresh. The rice was also cooked very well. The staff handled everything competently and professionally, from seating instructions to ordering. Food was served quickly and attentive service was provided, including clearing plates and filling water. The atmosphere was simple yet sophisticated, and there was good lighting for taking pictures. However, it can get a bit crowded during peak weekend hours, so we highly recommend making a reservation. The prices are reasonable and the portions are generous. You can enjoy it at a cheaper price if you make a group reservation. It would be better if a more diverse and creative dessert menu, including seasonal desserts, was added. Overall, this is a restaurant you'll want to visit again, perfect for a gathering of family or friends.
